verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-Markdown and web search API. It is a tool that agents consume, not an agent or host that runs tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The probe showing an official Jina MCP server is server-side evidence and does not transfer to this client story. Nothing in the pack shows Reader consuming MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
